tool_args.rationale: The observed signature and s_grad span are consistent with the standard two-layer siphon branch, not the high-gradient avalanche regime. Numerically fit vmax, rho, and signed c_loc from the five existing rows; defer additional measurements pending fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five varied pilot rows identify the three parameters of the guided siphon-plus-square-root model; a probe is not needed to resolve the current parameter ambiguity.
Observed s_grad values are at most 2.2, below the stated supercritical gray-zone trigger of 2.36.
The pilots include a nonmonotonic pattern against u_now at varying s_grad, while the supplied signatures and subtree guidance favor the coupled sink-gradient siphon form.
